title: Harvest Load Vendor Form
subtitle: Harvest Load capture supplier identity, qualification evidence, capability, record delivery, risk conditions, approval terms, and periodic review ownership.
description: An original, workflow-complete harvest load vendor review covering identity and routing, domain observations and evidence, accountable decisions, exceptions and escalation, and completion handoff without replacing qualified judgment.
use_case: Use when evaluating or renewing a vendor whose products or services affect the named farm or food workflow and require documented conditions and escalation. The record is owned by the harvest and shipping owner and closes only after evidence, exceptions, disposition, and the next accountable handoff are documented.

sections.title: Harvest Load vendor review routing
sections.guidance: Identify the vendor, category, subject, and review owner.

blocks.label: Vendor Review identity and routing
blocks.guidance: Assign one owner and use the same record ID in attachments and follow-up.

blocks.label: Harvest Load vendor review scope
blocks.guidance: Define the operating scope that this review may approve, condition, or exclude.

sections.title: Harvest Load vendor identity and qualification
sections.guidance: Capture evidence for review without claiming certification.

blocks.label: Harvest Load qualification evidence
items: Harvest, hauling, container, or equipment scope is defined
Crop, volume, season, service area, and capacity are documented
Crew or operator qualification evidence is routed as applicable
Equipment, cleaning, maintenance, and inspection records are available
Container, pallet, label, seal, and traceability controls are described
Scale, count, weight, and shipping document capability is documented
Cooling, storage, transport, and delay response are described
Rejected load, damage, contamination, and recall contacts are identified
Record delivery, correction, retention, and insurance review are routed

sections.title: Harvest Load vendor document review
sections.guidance: Track each item, reviewer, expiry or refresh point, and gap.

blocks.label: Vendor record controls
items: Vendor identity and contacts match submitted evidence
Document source, date, reviewer, and refresh point are recorded
Product or service scope matches the proposed harvest load use
Expired, missing, or conditional evidence remains visible
Corrections preserve the original record, reason, and responsible person
Required records can be delivered in the agreed format and timing

sections.title: Harvest Load capability and service levels
sections.guidance: Compare promised capability with evidence and operating constraints.

blocks.label: Seasonal capacity, dependencies, substitutions, and service limitations

sections.title: Harvest Load vendor decision
sections.guidance: Document approval scope, conditions, review frequency, and authority.

blocks.label: Vendor decision basis
items: Harvest Load qualification evidence matches the proposed scope
Capacity, response, substitutions, and dependencies were reviewed
Required records and escalation contacts can be delivered
Approval conditions, exclusions, and monitoring are explicit
Authorized reviewer assigned the status and renewal point

blocks.label: Approved scope, conditions, exclusions, monitoring, and renewal triggers

sections.title: Harvest Load vendor exceptions and escalation
sections.guidance: Keep expired evidence, performance gaps, and conditional work visible.

blocks.label: Vendor-review boundary
blocks.guidance: This record does not certify a vendor or replace qualified harvest load judgment. Approval is limited to the documented scope, conditions, evidence, and review period. Hold new or changed work and escalate missing evidence, substitutions, performance concerns, or decisions outside the reviewer’s authority.

blocks.label: Harvest Load vendor exception triggers
items: Required vendor evidence is missing, expired, or unverifiable
Proposed scope or capacity does not match the harvest load need
Product, part, method, or subcontractor substitution lacks review
Required operational records cannot be delivered or corrected
Performance, complaint, incident, or corrective-action concern is open
Approval authority, condition, insurance, or applicable review is pending

blocks.label: Gap, immediate safeguard, vendor response, owner, due point, and disposition

sections.title: Harvest Load vendor record closeout
sections.guidance: Transfer conditions, monitoring, renewal, and evidence ownership.

blocks.label: Harvest Load open actions and limitations
blocks.guidance: Carry forward every item that is not fully resolved at closeout.

blocks.label: Harvest Load handoff confirmations
items: Approved scope, conditions, and exclusions were recorded
Missing or expiring evidence has an owner and refresh date
Monitoring, performance review, and renewal points were assigned
Vendor and internal escalation contacts received the handoff
Harvest Load vendor evidence and decision record were filed
blocks.guidance: Unchecked items remain part of the open handoff.

blocks.label: Final outcome, remaining limits, communications, and acceptance notes
